title: Longest Road: free iPhone app to track your Catan wins | Khalid Farhan
metaDesc: Keep the win record for your Catan group: tribes, standings, rivalries, seasons and badges. Log a game in two taps. Free, no ads, by Khalid Farhan.

blocks.text: Game 1
One link. The same standings on every phone.
Make a tribe of 3 to 6 players and send one invite link. There is no sign-up: it uses your Apple ID through iCloud.
After a game, pick the winner and save. The date and time fill themselves in. Victory points, the expansion, a board photo and a note are there if you want them.
I play with two groups, so each tribe keeps its own players, games and standings.

Game 15
Wins earn badges. Losing runs earn the robber.
The robber sits on whoever has lost four or more in a row, until they win it back.

Every game, kept for good.
Each game keeps its number, winner, date and players, and you can filter the list by player or expansion. Tap anyone to see their record and badges.

blocks.text: End of the season
Someone gets crowned. Then it starts again.

Seasons run three months, a year, or until you end them. The winner goes in the hall of champions and all-time records stay. Share the standings to your group chat, or keep the leader on your home screen.
